unavailable_or_unclassified: The general old-record extension needs average CONDITIONAL initial Wasserstein distance, not unconditional marginal distance. This is a deterministic-macrostep marginal expectation guarantee, not full-record TV, random-wall-time accuracy, arbitrary stopping, all-times path accuracy or rare-data conditional assurance. Static hidden parameters, conditionally fresh native increments, actual isolation, accurate label reads and protected/paid latency are premises. Only synthetic calibration and exact fitted-population calculations were executed.
